verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI creative platform, so the axis applies. Pika's evidence covers generation apps, an API and an MCP server, but nothing about user-defined rules, triggers, or automatic actions on events. The API and MCP are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations, not a rules engine, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
